title: RawProjectConfig
description: A project configuration document, as parsed.

protocol.description: The protocol version this project runs under.

protocols.description: A local tree path or a pinned `git+ssh://`, `git+https://`, or `git+file://` repository.

schemas.description: Where project-owned JSON Schema contracts are.

store.description: Where the plan is kept. Absent means `markdown`.

ProfileVersionedRef.description: Reference to a profile, optionally pinned to a major version.

ProtocolRef.description: Reference to a protocol at a major version, such as `aep/1`.

RawHybrid.description: A hybrid store as written: four policy words and two stores, none defaulted.

authority.description: Whose copy is the record of truth: `local` or `replica`.

on_divergence.description: What happens to a write that lost: `refuse` or `record`.

on_unreachable.description: What a read does when the replica does not answer: `refuse` or `serve-stale`.

read.description: Where a read goes first: `local-first`, `replica-first` or `replica-only`.

RawStore.description:
Where a project keeps its plan, as written in `project.yaml` (wave H, story 1).

```yaml store: markdown                    # the default: `.engineering/planning/` store: { sqlite: plan.sqlite3 }    # one file, relative to `.engineering/` store: { postgres: "postgres://…" } store: hybrid: authority: local               # local | replica read: local-first              # local-first | replica-first | replica-only on_unreachable: refuse         # refuse | serve-stale on_divergence: record          # refuse | record local: markdown replica: { sqlite: plan.sqlite3 } ```

A hybrid's four policy words are **required** — the runtime's R-106 says a default here is a policy nobody chose being applied to somebody's data — and a document missing one is refused naming the word, by the parser.

postgres.description: A libpq connection string or URL.

hybrid.description: The composite's policy and its two halves.
